subject: Dashboard contract: no dead-end identifiers or summary signals
body:
New task T-0159 is assigned: make every summary signal and task-shaped identifier a deep link or a drawer action.

Leader evidence: T-0041 looks like something a human must handle, but the UI gives no obvious operation; Reports blocker IDs and Plan drift counts are dead text; summary cards say “needs action” but the destination does not reliably preserve the filter.

Contract:
- One shared TaskLink behavior opens TaskDecisionDrawer everywhere.
- Summary cards deep-link to owning filtered lists; zero-count cards are visibly non-actions.
- Blocker IDs open the blocker task or a blocker-filtered list.
- Milestones open a milestone-filtered view.
- Keyboard activation and back/forward preservation.
- Playwright proves at least one link from each surface and that the destination is filtered.

Please keep T-0156, T-0157, T-0158, and T-0159 together in the current dashboard batch. Confirm receipt.
